pattern.description: After a hard cut, the frame slides left from the blurred V onto an oversized '4'; the numeral's left stroke resolves from grey to deep green as it settles, still heavily defocused, so 'v4' is spelled one giant glyph at a time.
pattern.why_premium: Revealing the product name glyph by glyph at a scale bigger than the frame, with motion blur and soft focus, makes the name feel monumental and lets the narration ('The next frontier') land on it.

build_hint.gsap: Container of giant glyphs: gsap.fromTo(track, {x:'+=420'}, {x:0, duration:0.2, ease:'power3.out'}) right after the cut; on the 4 gsap.fromTo(leftStroke gradient stop, {color:'#9a9a9a'}, {color:'#0b3d12', duration:0.25, ease:'power2.out'}) and keep filter:'blur(14px)' constant (rack focus happens later).
build_hint.remotion: translateX = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:200}}), [0, 1], [420, 0]) on a row of oversized glyphs (no overshoot); gradient colour mixes via interpolateColors(frame, [0, 8], ['#9a9a9a', '#0b3d12']); CSS blur fixed.

notes: The first energy spike is a cut into shot s011, so most of the change is the cut plus a short left slide. Candidate b02 is a thin sliver at b01's right edge with no distinct element, so it is not used. Camera move is none; pan_x -0.42 is the glyph track sliding.
